content: Automatic metrics provide a proxy to quantify the quality of the adversarial examples. To validate that these metrics work, we conduct a crowdsourcing experiment on Figure-Eight. Recall that the automatic metrics do not assess sentiment preservation (criterion (d)); we evaluate that aspect here.
